props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value (uncontrolled).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the control is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description:
The id of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to, instead of the closest
ancestor form.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description:
`Intl.NumberFormat` options used to format values for `aria-valuetext`, such as
`{ style: 'percent' }`. Formatting uses the provider locale.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the control element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Optional inner input element ref.

props.name: label
props.description:
Content shown at the start of the track. Also used as the default `aria-label` when it is a
string. It renders in both the track and fill text layers, so pass JSX inline rather than a
shared node.

props.name: marker
props.description:
Visual markers on the track. `true` marks every `step` and needs a `step` greater than 0.
A number marks every that many units without affecting snapping.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value of the slider.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value of the slider.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the control, used for form submission.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the slider selection changes during interaction.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Callback when the slider selection change is committed.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the control is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the control is required.

props.name: reversed
props.description: Reverses value movement along the track.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: step
props.description:
Step increment between values.
When omitted, pointer movement is continuous.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description:
Visual alignment of the thumb at the track ends.
`'overflow'` centers the thumb on the value so half of it extends past
the track at `min` and `max`. `'contain'` clamps the thumb inside the
track so its edges stay within bounds. Value mapping is unaffected.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this slider instance.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: valueLabel
props.type: boolean | ((props: { percent: number; value: number; max: number }) => string)
props.description:
Whether to show the value at the end of the track, or a formatter for it. `percent` is the
filled share of the track from 0 to 100.
By default the value is rounded to the decimal places of `step`, or to 2 decimal places without `step`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Fill treatment. `subtle` uses a solid neutral fill (`muted-active`), so the label, value, and
indicator keep the same colors over the fill and the track. `solid` uses the primary color
and switches the label, value, and indicator to `primary-foreground` over the fill.
